nodes.label: JAX Simulation Loop (Init→Rollout→PPO→Repeat)
nodes.rationale: Four-phase training loop: init grid/populations/network; lax.scan rollout of observe→forward→act→env-step; GAE+PPO gradient update outside scan; repeat for n_updates.

nodes.label: lax.scan JIT Rollout Kernel
nodes.rationale: Each sim_step inside scan is @jit-compiled; entire T-step rollout becomes one XLA kernel. Params passed through carry with stop_gradient during rollout.

nodes.label: Rollout-to-CPU VRAM Strategy
nodes.rationale: Full T×N rollout (~2.4GB obs alone) moved off GPU before PPO backward; XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.80 leaves headroom.

nodes.label: Dual-Team Blue/Red PPO Training
nodes.rationale: Separate b_params/r_params, optimizers, and rollout batches; blue limited red sensing; red curriculum floor applied outside JIT.

nodes.label: Red Population Curriculum
nodes.rationale: Red floor advances through stages when blue survival ≥80% sustained for 5 updates; reproduction enforces min_pop floor per stage.

nodes.label: Brain Vote (Capacity-Based Layer Growth)
nodes.rationale: When entropy+signal diversity plateau, VF loss high, and survival low, n_layers increments up to brain_max_layers; sim_step_fn rebuilt.

nodes.label: Evolutionary Distillation Outer Loop
nodes.rationale: CPU outer loop keeps top 5% by age elites, kills rest, respawns dead slots with noisy parent carries; disabled under pmap.

nodes.label: Signal Corpus Recording
nodes.rationale: SignalCorpusWriter samples alive blue agents with scout labels (red within alarm_scout_range), lag-1 neighbor scout signals for decode/LRT analysis.

nodes.label: Local JAX Compilation Cache (Modal)
nodes.rationale: Volume-mounted JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR deserializes slowly and looks like hang; redirected to /tmp/throng_jax_cache on Modal.

nodes.label: Phase 9 Auxiliary Loss Pipeline
nodes.rationale: After each team PPO update: auxiliary_update for fwd_env, carry_fwd (Phase 11), and self_pred; metrics logged on dashboard.

nodes.label: Phase 9.4 Cross-Attention Receiver
nodes.rationale: Optional cross_attn_enabled from phase9_canvas config; Q=self+carry, KV=neighbor signals → single Other token.

nodes.label: Orbax Checkpoint Resume
nodes.rationale: Saves b_params/r_params only; graft_missing_param_subtrees for schema evolution; population always starts fresh on restore.

nodes.label: Flax Transformer Agent Brain
nodes.rationale: Tokenized obs (own, nb_signals, local_symbols, env, own_signal, memory, culture) → embed → transformer blocks → multi-head outputs.

nodes.label: VQ Signal Bottleneck (STE)
nodes.rationale: Continuous z_e quantized to codebook; straight-through estimator; dead_code_reset replaces unused codes with batch z_e vectors.

nodes.label: Carry Fusion (Recurrent State)
nodes.rationale: Carry added as global bias to all tokens; new_carry = 0.9*old + 0.1*pooled; PPO uses exact historical carries from rollout.

nodes.label: Auxiliary Prediction Heads
nodes.rationale: head_fwd_1/2 predict loc_env_{t+1}; head_self_pred predicts action_{t+1}; head_fwd_dyn_1/2 predict carry_{t+1} (Phase 11).

nodes.label: NeighborCrossAttention Module
nodes.rationale: Phase 9.4: LayerNorm(self+carry) as query, embedded neighbor signals as KV; residual on self_encoded.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Schema Grafting
nodes.rationale: graft_missing_param_subtrees and ensure_aux_head_params inject AUX_HEAD_KEYS, VQ codebook, nb_cross_attn when resuming older Orbax checkpoints.

nodes.label: PPO Update Flow
nodes.rationale: Rollout on CPU → compute_gae → flatten T×N → shuffle → minibatch _minibatch_step JIT backward; one minibatch on GPU at a time.

nodes.label: Simplified GAE (Discounted Returns)
nodes.rationale: CPU numpy loop; lam parameter kept for API compat but unused; advantages = normalized (returns - values), clipped to [-10,10].

nodes.label: PPO Loss (Clipped Surrogate + Huber VF)
nodes.rationale: Uses historical carries with stop_gradient; clipped value loss; entropy bonus; optional VQ loss from rollout; alive mask for dead agents.

nodes.label: Auxiliary Update (Fwd + Carry + Self-Pred)
nodes.rationale: Pairs t→t+1 transitions; targets loc_env from obs[t+1] and carry[t+1] with stop_gradient; self_pred cross-entropy on action[t+1].

nodes.label: Hot Module Reload (train_entry)
nodes.rationale: Evicts cached jax_sim.* and communication.* from sys.modules before import; asserts observations_jax and SignalCorpusWriter are current.

nodes.label: Red Sense API v2
nodes.rationale: Per-agent Chebyshev distance to nearest live red; zeros loc_env red channel when beyond effective detection radius; shelter doubles det_r.

nodes.label: Blue Limited Red Sensing
nodes.rationale: Blues call build_observations_jax with limit_red_sensing=True; reds get full red_map visibility.

nodes.label: Grid Ecology Layers
nodes.rationale: Immutable GridState pytree: symbols, walls, resources, shelter, contested, scent, cultural fast/slow, puzzle layers.

nodes.label: Shelter Catch Protection
nodes.rationale: Shelter spots generated at init; blues on shelter cannot be caught by reds (applied in main_jax sim_step).

nodes.label: Contested Resource Cooperation
nodes.rationale: High-yield contested nodes require 2+ blue agents co-located to harvest bonus energy.

nodes.label: Fixed-Size Population Masking
nodes.rationale: max_pop slots fixed at init; alive boolean masks dead agents; no dynamic array resizing for JAX scan compatibility.

nodes.label: Mind-Melding (Carry Blending)
nodes.rationale: Optional older_to_younger carry blending within radius; rate-controlled interpolation with neighbor mean carries.

nodes.label: Background Training Entry (run_bg)
nodes.rationale: nohup entry for Modal/volume; hot-resume from checkpoints; Phase 9.4 canvas target 250k steps; does not wipe checkpoints.

nodes.label: P10.5 Hard-Ceiling Modal Config
nodes.rationale: Overrides config_phase7.yaml: pop 200, red 250 fixed, gamma 0.999, catch_prob 0.8 safety bubble, checkpoints at /mnt/throng-runs/checkpoints.

nodes.label: Modal GPU Environment Setup
nodes.rationale: Sets XLA mem fraction 0.80, cuda_malloc_async, local /tmp/throng_jax_cache before importing train_entry.

nodes.label: Post-PPO VQ Dead Code Reset
nodes.rationale: After PPO+aux, dead_code_reset_codebook_params persists unused codebook rows from rollout z_e embeddings.

nodes.label: Predator Jitter (catch_prob)
nodes.rationale: red_catch_prob < 1.0 gives blues probabilistic escape when in catch radius; P10.5 sets 0.8 safety bubble.

nodes.label: Emergent Proto-Language Hypothesis
nodes.rationale: Proto-language must emerge from multi-agent survival pressure alone—no human text and no communication-shaped rewards.

nodes.label: NeighborCrossAttention (9.4)
nodes.rationale: Q=self+carry over neighbor signals; residual on self; yields one Other token so Self and World bifurcate before model-based planning.

nodes.label: Confidence Head (9.1)
nodes.rationale: Epistemic uncertainty on head_fwd_dyn; penalize high-uncertainty imagined actions.

nodes.label: Solipsistic World-Model Failure
nodes.rationale: Carry entangles Self+World; imagination without Other pathway caused Stay≈99% value exploitation.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 393 (Do Not Resume)
nodes.rationale: Post active-imagination weights; associated with Stay collapse.

nodes.label: CPU Rollout Offload PPO (H2D)
nodes.rationale: 8077a12/d4cf614 path: rollout tensors CPU-offloaded before PPO; stability over GPU-resident speed.

nodes.label: B200 Rollout OOM (Fragmentation)
nodes.rationale: XLA BFC fragmentation after long runs at lax.scan rollout—not model size; TF_GPU_ALLOCATOR=cuda_malloc_async mitigates.

nodes.label: NB_GAIN↔surv nan at Ceiling
nodes.rationale: Blues at population cap with ~99% survival removes death variance so neighbor-signal benefit cannot be selected.

nodes.label: No Comm Reward Shaping
nodes.rationale: Scout/alarm shaped rewards or blind VQ loss shaping would invalidate the emergence experiment.

nodes.label: Bottom-Up Emergence Bet
nodes.source_location: What THRONG Is Trying to Do
nodes.rationale: Survival pressure selects communication and culture; falsify claims via dashboard numbers not narrative.

nodes.label: Forward Dynamics Head (9.2)
nodes.rationale: Signal-conditioned obs prediction makes channel load-bearing; ablation ΔMSE is falsification test.

nodes.label: Dedicated Other Pathway
nodes.rationale: Cure solipsistic world-models by reading neighbor proto-language via cross-attention instead of flat per-neighbor tokens only.

nodes.label: stop_gradient(carry_{t+1}) Target
nodes.rationale: Without stop_gradient the network learns trivial 0.9 carry mixing identity not true dynamics.

nodes.label: Modal Popen run_bg (not nohup)
nodes.rationale: Modal Jupyter rejects nohup and bare cd /root/throng; subprocess.Popen survives cell interrupts.

nodes.label: phase9_canvas.cross_attn_enabled
nodes.rationale: Default false for scaffold; enable true to JIT-compile 9.4 path with new nb_cross_attn params.

nodes.label: distill_enabled: false
nodes.rationale: P4b selective squeeze: no periodic population wipe during raw selection test.

nodes.label: VQ Discrete Token Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: Phase 4: signal head outputs vocab_size logits; Gumbel-Softmax in train, hard argmax in eval; token_embed maps discrete IDs back to continuous signal_dim vectors for neighbour consumption.

nodes.label: MAPPO Alive-Only Advantage Normalization
nodes.rationale: Advantages normalized over alive agents only; buffer compacted to alive rows before GPU transfer — standard MAPPO practice when most agents are dead.

nodes.label: Signal Head Entropy Bonus
nodes.rationale: Optional sig_ent_coef penalizes VQ token monoculture during PPO by maximizing entropy over signal_logits.

nodes.label: Signal Corpus
nodes.rationale: Append-only JSONL of sampled blue-agent emissions (sig, action, scout flag, spatial context, lag-1 scout fields, optional vq_token) spanning multiple resume sessions.

nodes.label: Decode Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Offline language analysis: load JSONL corpus → k-means vocabulary → Spearman/MI per dim → lag-1 communication LRT → topographic similarity → categorical vocabulary tests → VQ token direction test → optional withdrawal comparison.

nodes.label: 145k Scaffolding Withdrawal Test
nodes.rationale: At step 145k signals zeroed for 2k steps to test whether learned vocabulary persists without live communication channel.
